f64.description: f64 reference, machine A vs machine B. Every value within 1e-12 + 1e-11·max(|a|,|b|).

f32cpu.description: f32 CPU engine, machine A vs machine B. The f32 libm differs between platforms (probes: log10f, expf, powf). Apple M1 Pro vs Ryzen 5 3600 with MSVC, worst on this matrix (2026-10-22): 4.7e-6 absolute, 2.2x the first gate of 2e-6; gates about 2x that.

f64_border.description: f64 reference with a border: the frame is drawn with f32 powf/exp (film35.rs, border.rs). About 4 f32 ulps. The photo itself is gated strictly by the same case without a border.

cpu_grain.description: CPU engine with grain, applied only after the strict gate failed (status PASS-GRAIN). A last-bit change can flip a grain count; bounded so the change stays far below one 8-bit step.

gpu.description: GPU engine without grain, machine A vs machine B. Apple M1 Pro (Metal) vs GTX 1660 SUPER (Vulkan), worst on this matrix (2026-10-22): de00_max 0.0020, p999 0.0008, 1 step in 8 bit; gates about 10x that.

gpu_grain.description: GPU engine with grain, machine A vs machine B. The samplers use the GPU's log/exp, whose precision differs by vendor, so some draws differ and the grain blur spreads each one: single clumps can differ by de00 20, so there is no per-pixel limit. Apple M1 Pro vs GTX 1660 SUPER, worst on this matrix (2026-10-22): de00_mean 0.030, p99 0.60, frac_de00_gt_1 0.0049, frac_de00_gt_2 0.0014, rms_norm 9.2e-4; gates about 2x that.

gpu_vs_ref.description: GPU vs f64 reference on one machine, grain off. Apple M1 Pro worst on this matrix (2026-10-22): de00_max 0.0054, p99 0.0040, 1 step in 8 bit; gates about 10x that. Commit 36ad0ce measured up to 0.19 on full-resolution photos, so full-resolution runs may need their own profile.

self.description: A dump against itself with its TIFF: only the TIFF self-consistency check.
